summary:
The system follows the ТЗ §1.5 stack exactly. nginx is the edge: TLS 1.3, mTLS for РиН, the 50/200 MB limits and rate limiting. Behind it is one NestJS 11 + Fastify codebase running as two processes: an HTTP API and a worker (orchestrator, result ingest, protocol renderer, РиН outbox, notifications, scheduler). Stateless Python 3.12 workers (FastStream on RabbitMQ) handle parse/OCR, extraction, comparison, hypotheses and training, and an internal FastAPI ml-api serves sync operations of 500 ms or less. PostgreSQL 17 is the only system of record. S3/MinIO holds immutable, hash-addressed artifacts. Redis is split into an LRU cache (parse results by file hash, as §9.1 requires) and a no-eviction state store (sessions, idempotency, locks).

The comparison engine runs in Python. It needs unit and fuzzy matching, embeddings, geometry and CV diffs. The §14.3 evaluation and the §9.4 release gate must run the same code offline, so production and evaluation cannot drift. Node assembles, versions, verifies and finalizes the protocol. Python never changes a human decision, and Node never computes a finding. Only Node writes domain tables; results come back as a JSON file in S3 referenced by a small RabbitMQ message. The trainer reads through read-only SQL views.

Contracts are defined before code: one enums.yaml generates SQL CHECKs, TS, Python and OpenAPI enums; OpenAPI 3.0.3 is validated on both requests and responses, with a boot-time handler check and Schemathesis; AsyncAPI covers every RabbitMQ message; JSON Schemas cover the protocol, run manifest and GOLD items. The data model covers all 16 §10 tables under ТЗ names plus about 30 supporting tables. It has immutability and hash-chain triggers, versioned matrix snapshots so thresholds change without recoding, and copy-on-version protocols with stable finding keys for incremental updates.

Docker Compose has profiles for infra, core, mocks, train, monitoring, logging, llm and tools, with a hybrid dev mode and a Homebrew fallback until Docker is installed. The build plan uses 10 agents: AG-00 freezes contracts first (CP0), then parallel work on mocks, a thin-slice e2e at CP1, feature-complete at CP2 and a release candidate at CP3. 84 ARC requirements: 73 FULL, 9 SIMPLIFIED (internal TLS, at-rest encryption, SLA/RTO/RPO, 152-ФЗ, DDoS, usability test, mTLS, РиН auto-pull, prescriptions), 1 MOCKED (УКЭП signing), 1 OUT_OF_SCOPE (IDS).

too_complex.why: Internal TLS across 10+ containers is config-heavy and fragile for a laptop MVP
too_complex.proposal: Edge TLS 1.3-only is mandatory; internal TLS behind a TLS_INTERNAL profile; MinIO SSE, PII column encryption (pgcrypto/AES-GCM), encrypted backups; host disk encryption documented

too_complex.proposal: Copy-on-version protocols, stable finding_key, carry a decision over only if source hashes are unchanged, param↔discipline impact map, explicit «источник обновлён» flag

summary:
B01 covers the intake side of Module 1 and the intake-related negative scenarios from Module 12. The design is registry-first and stamp-verified: the mandatory CSV/XLSX/JSON registry is the authority for stage, шифр, revision, approval status and predecessor/successor. Title-block extraction (ГОСТ Р 21.101 form 3/4-6 template on the text layer, OCR only on cell crops) cross-checks the registry and auto-fills a draft registry in a UI helper. Approval status is never auto-assumed. A missing registry leaves the package CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED until a human confirms a registry.

Inspecting the pilot PDF gave four facts that shape the design:
- The organiser file_ids (ALT79B-000015 etc.) appear nowhere in the pages. They must be kept exactly and echoed in all outputs to score file_id+page matches.
- Sheet ≠ page, with variable offsets, so sheet_page_range is derived automatically.
- ПД and РД шифры of the same object often differ; UNDMS has completely different bases. Cross-stage linkage is therefore object + discipline family + scope, with a seed discipline map built from §6.
- Pages fall into three content classes: vector with a text layer, vector with text drawn as curves, and raster scans (one at 200 dpi, one at 150 dpi). A throw-away prototype read the шифр exactly on 15 of 20 stamped sheets, the stage on 19/20 and the sheet number on 17/20, and every failure has a known cause.

Revision selection is a deterministic pure function. It resolves automatically only from explicit chains or SUPERSEDED/CANCELLED marks. Two approved revisions with no link produce CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED with a one-click suggestion. An invariant, checked by property tests, guarantees a superseded revision is never the reference.

Completeness has two layers. Layer A compares what the registry declares with what was received (the ТЗ example «5 из 15»). Layer B is a normative checklist: ПП 87 sections, РД composition, and ИД per 344/пр with Приложение 19 sub-items, filtered by object profile and construction phase. Only CORE items can make a stage PARTIAL. B01 computes the upload statuses and scenario + scenario_base (names aligned with B04), plus an RFC 8785 input_manifest_hash. After each change it publishes a delta event so B04 recomputes only the affected parameters.

Intake: streaming upload with 50/200 MiB limits, magic-byte format checks, SHA-256 of the raw bytes, quarantine, fail-closed ClamAV scan before storage, and a content-addressed write-once AES-GCM store with a daily integrity check. Async work runs over RabbitMQ with a transactional outbox, deadline-based timeouts, 2 retries and an admin alert, and a Redis cache keyed by hash plus parser version. Uploads are gated by process status exactly as in the §9.1 table, and a finalised process offers a successor check. MVP stance: 69 FULL, 19 SIMPLIFIED, 3 OUT_OF_SCOPE (linear objects, cryptographic УКЭП validation, extracting the hidden-works list from «Общие данные»).

too_complex.item: Title-block (штамп) extraction to Exact Match ≥ 0.90 on scans and on vector pages whose text is drawn as curves
too_complex.why: Pilot pages come in three classes: vector with a text layer, vector with SHX text as curves (p9: 27k paths, 0 chars), and raster scans (p14 at 200 dpi; p3/p5 at 150 dpi). Codes are split across spans, sometimes contaminated by neighbouring cells or truncated in the text layer. Tesseract has no rus pack installed.
too_complex.proposal: Stay registry-first so linkage never depends on OCR. Parse stamps from the text layer with template-cell snapping to vector ruling lines. Fall back to OCR only on small cell crops at 400 dpi with field whitelists; return ABSTAIN when confidence is low. Require human confirmation in the registry helper and report EM plus coverage honestly.

too_complex.item: Sheet-scope revisions (sheets re-issued as Зам./Нов./Аннул.)
too_complex.why: Russian RD practice revises individual sheets, which needs sheet-level identity and change-register parsing.
too_complex.proposal: Resolve per sheet only when the registry declares revision_scope=SHEETS plus sheet_page_range; otherwise resolve at document level. Show stamp revision rows as evidence.

too_complex.item: Full ИД completeness (Приложение 19 has about 80 work-dependent sub-items)
too_complex.why: ИД accumulates as construction progresses, and the list of hidden works lives in RD «Общие данные».
too_complex.proposal: Use the 13 items of 344/пр as the top level with Приложение 19 children, split CORE vs EXPECTED. Derive applicability from present RD families, the object profile and construction phase, applying Прил.19's «по окончании строительства» list as a phase rule. Let the inspector mark items NOT_APPLICABLE with a basis. Extracting the hidden-works list from «Общие данные» is a stretch goal.

too_complex.item: Cryptographic УКЭП verification and visual requisites check on scans
too_complex.why: Needs GOST crypto (CryptoPro and CA chains); CV detection of signatures and seals is unreliable.
too_complex.proposal: Detect presence only: PDF /Sig and /ByteRange, XML-DSig, a blue-ink/seal blob heuristic and date regex. Label results «подпись не проверена криптографически» and have the inspector confirm.

too_complex.item: Encryption at rest for both DB and file store
too_complex.why: PostgreSQL has no native TDE.
too_complex.proposal: App-level AES-256-GCM for file blobs (demonstrable), DB on an encrypted volume, pgcrypto for ПДн columns.

too_complex.item: DOCX/XML page and bbox addressing
too_complex.why: DOCX has no fixed pages; XML has no pages at all.
too_complex.proposal: Treat a LibreOffice/Gotenberg PDF rendition as the paged form, hash-linked to the original; evidence references the rendition page. XML evidence uses an XPath locator with page=null.

too_complex.item: Thousands of files per object vs the 200 MB package limit
too_complex.why: Pilot file sequences reach 003642 per object.
too_complex.proposal: UI auto-chunks uploads into ≤200 MiB packages within one process. The registry must scale to thousands of rows. Provide a batch CLI for hidden-test runs.

too_complex.item: Local environment gaps
too_complex.why: Docker, RabbitMQ, ClamAV, qpdf and LibreOffice are not installed; Tesseract lacks rus.
too_complex.proposal: brew install rabbitmq and clamav (with freshclam), plus LibreOffice or Gotenberg later. pikepdf bundles qpdf. Download tessdata_best rus. Verify an arm64 ClamAV image (fallback: Debian clamav-daemon); clamd needs about 1–1.5 GB RAM.

tz_issues.issue: The upload performance scenario of 10 files × 50 MB (500 MB) contradicts the 200 MB package limit, which rejects the whole package.
tz_issues.recommendation: A package is one upload request of 200 MiB. Measure 10 files ≤200 MB in one package, and 10×50 MB as 3 sequential packages into the same process.

tz_issues.issue: «без реестра пакет принимается со статусом CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED», but CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED is defined as a finding/verification status, not a package status.
tz_issues.recommendation: Set package registry_status=MISSING and package_status=CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED. Every file in the package is CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED for reference selection, and no violation conclusions are made until a registry is confirmed.

tz_issues.issue: Process statuses (COMPLETED/FINALIZED) and verification statuses (VERIFICATION_COMPLETED/PROTOCOL_FINALIZED) use different names; PENDING means different things in the two tables; §9.3 carries the title of §9.2.
tz_issues.recommendation: The process API uses §9.1 names and protocol/verification objects use §9.3 names, with a documented 1:1 mapping. Candidate PENDING is a separate enum.

tz_issues.issue: «повреждённый PDF → отклонение» vs «файл нечитаем / листы не сопоставлены → NOT_COMPARABLE».
tz_issues.recommendation: Files that are structurally broken (cannot open, truncated, encrypted) are rejected at intake. Files that open but are unusable (illegible, low DPI, OCR failure, unmapped sheets, timeout) are accepted as NOT_COMPARABLE with a request for replacement.

tz_issues.issue: The §3 table lists 13 ПД sections (including ТХ, БЭ, ИН), while the Matrix uses ПОД and ЗУ and lacks ТХ/БЭ/ИН. ИОС numbering in §3 (ИОС2 and ИОС3 are both ВК, no gas) differs from ПП 87, and the pilot code uses ИОС5.4.2.
tz_issues.recommendation: Key everything by section code rather than number. The completeness template is the union of both lists with applicability rules. The normaliser handles both ИОС<n> and ИОС5.<n>.<k>.

tz_issues.issue: The budget rule «разделов 6, 11, 5 и 9» reads as ТХ/ОДИ/ИОС/ППМ under the §3 numbering but looks like the pre-2022 ПП 87 numbering (ПОС, смета, ИОС, ПБ), which is also what the Matrix numbering follows.
tz_issues.recommendation: Implement it as a configurable applicability rule keyed by section codes, default to the literal §3 reading, and ask the organisers. Impact is low.

tz_issues.issue: Registry fields (file_name, SHA-256, successor_id, sheet_page_range, signature_status) are missing from the Files table, and the hash field is named file_hash vs SHA-256.
tz_issues.recommendation: Make Files a superset of the ТЗ columns, keeping ТЗ names verbatim, and document the registry↔Files column mapping.

tz_issues.issue: It is unclear who assigns file_id; Files has only `id`.
tz_issues.recommendation: Files.id is the registry file_id: external, immutable, and echoed in all outputs, which is required to score against GOLD. Generate <OBJ>-<NNNNNN> only when there is no registry. The same id with a different hash returns 409.

tz_issues.issue: «Повторная загрузка создаёт новую запись и новую версию протокола» makes byte-identical re-uploads create noise.
tz_issues.recommendation: Different bytes create a new record and a new protocol version. Identical bytes are idempotent: the upload event is audited, and no new record or protocol version is created.

tz_issues.issue: «Повторная попытка обработки (до 2 раз)» could mean 2 attempts or 2 retries.
tz_issues.recommendation: Read it as 2 retries (3 attempts), then notify the admin; the file becomes NOT_COMPARABLE and the process continues.

tz_issues.issue: PARTIALLY_LOADED («5 из 15 файлов ИД») overlaps the other scenarios, and the source of the expected count («15») is undefined.
tz_issues.recommendation: The expected count comes from the registry-declared rows plus CORE checklist items. Return both `scenario` and `scenario_base`.

tz_issues.issue: Only PDF/DOCX/XML are allowed, yet electronic ИД often arrives with detached .sig files, and §11 mentions «CV-анализ … (DWG)».

summary: B02 designs Module 1 part B, a Python 3.11 ml-extractor worker driven through RabbitMQ that extracts values from PDF, DOCX and XML with located, typed evidence. Pilot inspection showed that routing must be decided per page and per region: 18 vector pages, 4 hybrid (full-page or tiled raster plus a text layer), 1 page whose text is converted to outlines (p9), and 1 real 200-dpi scan (p14). The expert red markup is vector page content (width 4.0 = evidence box) and reproduces all 27 GOLD bboxes at IoU >= 0.997. The white Ink annotations are redactions with text still underneath, so extraction must be visibility-aware and pilot files need a sanitizer. The normalized-coordinate math (visible CropBox∩MediaBox, after Rotate, top-left origin) was verified on 7 synthetic fixtures: formula, PyMuPDF and rendered pixels agree. The primary OCR is PP-OCRv5 via RapidOCR/ONNX Runtime, measured at 0.97–0.98 char accuracy on clean tables and title blocks versus 0.77–0.92 for Tesseract rus; Tesseract stays as fallback and orientation engine. Throughput is 1.12 s per dense A4 page with 4x3 workers on the M2 Max CPU, so 100 pages take about 112 s and 500 pages about 9.3 min, which meets §11. For semantic anchors, multilingual-e5-small replaces the English-only all-MiniLM-L6-v2: 34/40 top-1 and 38/40 top-3 at about 8 ms per query, far inside the 500 ms budget. Explication, ТЭП, spec and deviation tables are the key structured source for most pilot findings. CV is kept realistic: vector geometry, per-viewport scale voting (recovered 1:100 and 1:200 correctly), distances, room label sets, and stamp/seal/handwriting detection; no symbol recognition. The MVP stance is deterministic by default: hand-tuned profiles for about 35 parameters plus generic profiles for the other 97, honest per-parameter extraction status, LOW_QUALITY/ABSTAIN with coverage reporting, a Redis cache keyed by version-aware SHA-256, and an optional grounded local VLM that is off by default.

summary: B03 turns the 132-parameter matrix into data plus an executable, admin-tunable rule contract. It delivers matrix_enriched.json (132 objects, validated) and id_completeness_checklist.json (111 items from Appendix 19 and ТЗ §5, 94 leaves and 17 groups, with applicability and final-check flags). Every §8.1 field is filled: data_type, a draft regex_pattern (all compile, all ≤255 chars, 43/43 tests on real pilot strings pass), Russian semantic anchors, and SP/GOST/FZ/other references (294 in total). Each reference carries a confidence level (108 HIGH, 144 MEDIUM, 42 LOW), and uncertain clauses are marked «требует проверки». The trigger texts are formalized into a JSON rule language with 14 rule types. Thresholds are references ($min_value, $object.*, $derived.*), so Module 8 changes numbers without recoding. The 76 composite params split into 218 atomic sub-checks, which satisfies §9.3's atomic findings. Feasibility tiers are A=38, B=63, C=27, D=4. The four tier-D ООС params (АИС ОСИГ, РНИС, КПТС, ГРОО) degrade honestly to MISSING_EVIDENCE, and tier-C geometry falls back to dimension text and SUSPICION instead of false candidates. The key domain finding is that the pilot area changes (ALT79B +0.49%, SOSH25 +0.29%, DOO25 −0.29%) all fall below the M-002 1% trigger. They are caught only by the room-level explication diff under M-003. In the same way, the only confirmed violation (OKT103) is an ИД-internal tolerance check (M-054.b), and the UNDMS finding is a layer removed from an assembly (M-044). Out-of-matrix pilot findings (IZM12 pile repair, LOS3A moved door) are handled by Logical_Rules and mining of the RD change log (Лист изменений). The report defines a strict trigger policy to protect the mandatory FPR ≤ 0.10, a phase-based rule for when a missing ИД stage counts as missing versus not applicable, and a canonical catalog of object facts. It also seeds 40 Logical_Rules (merged with B05's 12) and lists reconciliation items with the sibling reports: the POL16 mapping, the policy for deviations below a trigger, the JSONLogic vs custom rule-syntax split, and the «B03» numbering clash.

summary: B04 turns parsed PD/RD/ID extractions into evidence groups, keyed by object + matrix param or rule + scope. Each group carries separate completeness_status and finding_status fields and atomic findings, one per changed element (room, door, layer, axis), each on one comparison axis (PD↔RD, RD↔ID, or a single-stage normative check). The per-param pipeline runs in the ТЗ order (applicability → evidence completeness → revision currency/comparability → subject comparison), with a stored decision trace. Status precedence is NOT_APPLICABLE > MISSING_EVIDENCE > CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED > NOT_COMPARABLE, and a card validator guarantees that no CANDIDATE exists without complete, localized evidence. Comparison semantics are defined per data_type: number with a rounding epsilon, direction and abs/rel tolerance; enum ordinal scales with homoglyph folding (B35>B30, I>II, КМ0>КМ3, EI60>EI30); string via normalization, typo tolerance and a multilingual MiniLM analogue; boolean presence; coordinate distance. Keyed and ordered lists are aligned with Hungarian and Needleman-Wunsch alignment, and graphic configuration diffs use text-layer symbol sets plus axis-grid registration. The pilot drove key decisions. Five of the nine groups are room-explication diffs, and ALT79B and SOSH25 are candidates below the M-002 «>1%» trigger, so we propose a per-param candidate policy (any deviation vs trigger only) in which the trigger drives only the risk level. POL17 sets the stale-revision/negative control, and the change logs (UNDMS, LOS3A) are corroborating evidence, not approved changes. The bbox convention is verified: [x0,y0,x1,y1], top-left origin. The protocol JSON is a superset of the СХЕМА GOLD field names and is exported in the ПРИМЕРЫ notation, because it is effectively the scoring artefact. Приложение № 2 is missing, so we propose a layout that copies the organisers' «Графическая фиксация» style (blue ПД / red РД frames, «Вывод» box, disclaimer), wrapped in the mandatory sections and five tables. It is rendered from templates to PDF (Playwright/Chromium), DOCX, XML+XSD and JSON with content and manifest hashes. Incremental updates recompute only affected groups via a dependency index, carry inspector decisions over by evidence fingerprint, and keep immutable version history. All §11 budgets (≤2 min, ≤30 s, ≤1 min) are met with a large margin.

summary: Module 3 (Inspector Verification, High) is the only place where an AI CANDIDATE can become a legally meaningful CONFIRMED_VIOLATION, so the design centres on a keyboard-first verification workspace. It has three parts: a status-tabbed queue, with completeness shown separately from candidates as the ТЗ requires; 2–3 synchronized OpenSeadragon deep-zoom viewers fed by server-side PyMuPDF tiles, with blue expected / red actual overlays (the organizers' own markup colours), zoom-to-bbox and three sync modes; and an evidence card with every §9.2 p.4 field, including approved_change_ref. RD change-registration entries are shown only as information, because they are not an approved change (pilot UNDMS case). Statuses are split into four axes: model finding_status, completeness_status, inspector_status and process status. The API returns both ТЗ naming schemes (COMPLETED/FINALIZED and VERIFICATION_COMPLETED/PROTOCOL_FINALIZED), which resolves the naming conflicts, and PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED is impossible by schema. Decisions are append-only and committed in one transaction with audit, Rejection_Log/Dispute_Log and a transactional outbox to RabbitMQ. They are protected by optimistic locking (If-Match), idempotency keys and a seen-evidence-fingerprint guard. A deterministic, explainable rejection validator (text-layer origin, registry chain, thresholds, applicability, change-log vs approval) implements the §9.4 agree/disagree comments: a disagreement moves the rejection to CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED with a Dispute_Log row, and that blocks finalization until the inspector decides again. Uploads during verification trigger an incremental re-check, and seven fingerprint-based change classes decide which decisions survive. Only materially changed findings (e.g., a source superseded by a new revision) reopen, with one-click re-apply, so verification is never reset. Finalization runs behind a server gate, produces an immutable signed snapshot (demo signer, the only MOCKED item) and DB triggers lock the process; only an admin or supervisor can un-finalize, with a mandatory reason, returning to VERIFICATION_COMPLETED. The РиН payload is filtered to confirmed records plus versions and the file registry. The usability criteria (≤30 min, ≤3 clicks) are designed in (confirm = 2 actions, reject/clarify = 3, auto-advance, AI-prefilled reasons and comments) and proven by built-in telemetry, a facilitator console, SUS, and a ground-truth benchmark protocol «УТ-1» for the mandatory 5-inspector test (proxies as fallback). Of 75 atomic requirements, 63 are FULL, 11 SIMPLIFIED, 1 MOCKED and 0 out of scope.

summary:
B06 covers Module 4 (feedback and controlled retraining, High), Module 10 (weekly ML report, Medium) and a standalone evaluation harness for the §14.3 metrics.

The design is a closed, auditable loop. An inspector decision becomes a draft GOLD item. The item becomes curatable only after the protocol is finalized and an eligibility check against «СХЕМА GOLD» passes. The curator then releases a versioned dataset_version with sticky object_group_id splits and SHA-256 manifests. Training is manual and the internal HIDDEN_TEST is frozen before the first run. Evaluation reuses the harness code, and the gate checks every §14.3 threshold plus Recall no worse than −2 pp and FPR no worse than +2 pp, with exact arithmetic at the boundary. Publication requires a four-eyes, step-up-signed decision (digest plus Ed25519, with УКЭП pluggable later) and always allows rollback.

The ML stance is honest. With 9 pilot groups (1 positive, 1 negative), nothing parametric can be trained or validated. So the retrainable "model" is a versioned bundle of 6 components:
- Parametric: a calibrated candidate verifier (false-positive filter and risk ranker, LR or monotonic HGB) and per-category operating thresholds.
- Data-derived: a noise-tolerance table (never the normative thresholds), a multilingual anchor bank, an OCR confusion lexicon and approved-change patterns.
All six are gated identically.

To demonstrate the loop end to end, the plan uses about 150 labelled synthetic objects covering every §14.2 class, including rotated and cropped pages. A simulated inspector drives the real API, and everything synthetic is clearly badged.

AI system comments reproduce the §9.4 templates verbatim. When the AI disagrees with a rejection, it raises a dispute that puts the finding into CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED until the inspector re-decides in one click. `inspector-eval` is offline and Dockerized, reads the «СХЕМА GOLD» format (including the pilot compact notation and code aliases), verifies SHA-256, and reports n, coverage/abstention and 95% CI (Wilson plus object-cluster bootstrap). Its verdict is the AND of all thresholds, and a NOT_EVALUATED metric counts as a fail. The weekly report comes out as JSON, HTML and PDF, with rejection stats, a precision trend, an audit-sample FN estimate, PSI drift and rule-based recommendations; it is delivered in-app and by e-mail.

Checking the originals corrected two "known facts":
- The red expert markup is vector content appended at the tail of each page's content stream. It matches the ПРИМЕРЫ РАЗМЕТКИ bboxes exactly, and clean copies without it can be made.
- The Ink annotations are white, visual-only redactions over title blocks, and the text layer underneath is still intact. This is a PII risk.
In addition, no pilot page is rotated or cropped, so geometry normalization must be tested on synthetic pages.

block: B07-hypotheses (ТЗ Module 5 — Модуль свободного поиска гипотез, priority High)
summary: Module 5 is more important for scoring than its place in the ТЗ suggests. 6 of the 9 pilot groups and all 3 ventilation findings are room- or element-level changes, and IZM12 is a document-level «works in ИД without a РД basis» case. On three pilots (ALT79B, SOSH25, DOO25) the floor totals move by +0.49 %, +0.29 % and −0.29 %. That is below the M-002 trigger (>1 %), so only room-level analysis can flag them; I measured these values from the pilot PDFs. The pilot has no SUSPICION examples, which is why D1 (auto-promotion) and D2 (change-fact router) matter. D1 recommends a strict, auditable auto-promotion gate SUSPICION→CANDIDATE: complete evidence, which is the only precondition the ТЗ states, plus confidence ≥ 0.8 and a rule marked promotable. D2 sends matrix-mapped changes to Module 2 and everything else to SUSPICION, so nothing is counted twice. The design is one text-layer change-detection engine: room and element inventories built from explications, labels, system tags and layer lists. Five detectors run on it: a JSON-AST rule engine with three-valued logic over Logical_Rules (12 seed rules); semantic dissonance via room alignment, a function taxonomy, pymorphy3, rapidfuzz, multilingual MiniLM and a category-shift/antonym matrix; normative checks against Normative_Base with edition selection by effective_from/to; ML patterns via robust intra-object stats and IsolationForest plus a history store; and GRAPHIC_DIFF as an extension (label-based registration with quality gates, viewport-scoped directional diff, aggregation per room). The prototype confirmed exact explication extraction and label-based registration: scale 0.999 on ALT79B and the 2.0 scale of the SOSH25 fragment recovered. It also found an arithmetic inconsistency the experts did not mark: the ALT79B ПД rows sum to 2795.04 m² against a stated total of 2797.27 m². It also showed that raw page-level raster diff is unusable: the NEGATIVE_VERIFIED POL17 pair still has 13–19 % extra РД ink. SUSPICION is enforced at DB level, excluded from counts, training and РиН, deduplicated only within an object and its comparable revision fingerprint, and frozen at finalization. LLM use is optional, offline by default and never a source of evidence.

too_complex.item: Generic graphic drawing diff across arbitrary ПД/РД sheets
too_complex.why: Drawing types differ (schematic vs plan), as do scales and layouts. РД legitimately adds detailing: measured 13–19 % extra ink even on the NEGATIVE_VERIFIED POL17 pair. Label-based RANSAC can end up ill-conditioned when inliers fall in one column (ALT79B/LOS3A).
too_complex.proposal: Restrict to paired plan-type vector sheets. Use label-based registration with quality gates (≥6 inliers, ≥30 % spread in both axes, residual and scale checks) with an axis-grid/ORB fallback. Diff only inside the plan viewport, weighted toward 'missing in РД', aggregated per room, calibrated on POL17, LOW/MEDIUM unless a text detector corroborates. Schematic-vs-plan pairs (the vent example) go through text-anchored element inventories instead.

too_complex.item: Approach 4 'обучение на исторических данных' without any history
too_complex.why: No historical objects are provided, and §9.4 forbids SUSPICION labels in training.
too_complex.proposal: Use intra-object robust statistics now: cross-stage delta outliers (MAD z-scores) and identical-unit consistency, which carry a real signal on ALT79B and POL16. Add IsolationForest for n≥50 and reference priors. Fill a Quantity_History feature store from FINALIZED protocols. Use a labelled synthetic history for the demo. Cross-object and supervised models come later, under the Module 4 gates.

too_complex.item: Normative analysis facts such as room heights
too_complex.why: Heights are rarely explicit on plans, and deriving them from sections needs elevation parsing.
too_complex.proposal: The engine is FULL. Facts are limited to robust sources (areas from explications; heights only when explicit), otherwise UNKNOWN and no suspicion. The admin can edit min/max values to show changes without recoding.

too_complex.item: Logical rules needing full-set object facts (floors→lift, height>28 m→fire lift, parking→АУПТ)
too_complex.why: The pilot contains sheet excerpts only; no full ПД/РД sets.
too_complex.proposal: Ship and unit-test the rules; demo them on a clearly labelled synthetic object. Emphasise the rules that fire on real pilot data: explication sum (fires on ALT79B), ИД works without a РД basis (IZM12), ИД tolerance (OKT103).

too_complex.item: Exact normative clause citations
too_complex.why: A wrong СП/СанПиН clause in front of Мосгосстройнадзор experts damages credibility. The ТЗ's own examples look mis-attributed (2.5 m 'по СанПиН'; lift 'СП 54 п. 7.1.3').
too_complex.proposal: Seed references carry verified=false with a UI badge. The ТЗ strings are reproduced verbatim in demo rules and flagged. Get a short expert review.

too_complex.item: Embedding-based semantic dissonance
too_complex.why: Embeddings cannot detect category shifts or antonyms well: 'Техническое' vs 'Склад ГСМ' rate as fairly similar.
too_complex.proposal: Use embeddings only to map names to taxonomy categories. Dissonance comes from an explicit category-shift severity matrix plus an antonym/negation lexicon (pymorphy3), with rapidfuzz for typos (real case: 'Комтана отдыха').

too_complex.item: LLM integration
too_complex.why: Risks of hallucination, 152-ФЗ data leakage and slow CPU inference in Docker on Apple Silicon.
too_complex.proposal: A pluggable interface with a Noop default. The LLM is never a source of evidence or coordinates, and is used only for wording and optional second opinions. PII is scrubbed before any cloud call; cloud is enabled only after the user decides.

Proposed stack (versions checked on npm 2026-09-27): React 19.3, Vite 8, TypeScript 6.0 (typescript-eslint does not support TS 7 yet), Ant Design 6.6 with ru_RU and no ProComponents (they only support antd 5), TanStack Query 5, React Router 8 with nuqs for filters kept in the URL, and Orval to generate hooks, zod schemas and MSW mocks from the single OpenAPI 3.0 spec, so frontend agents can start before the backend exists. Object colour uses a strict rule computed and stored on the server by one shared TS function: red only when there is a CONFIRMED_VIOLATION, yellow when inspector action or data is needed (pending CANDIDATE, CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, MISSING_EVIDENCE, NOT_COMPARABLE, partial upload, missing registry), green when evidence is complete and nothing is confirmed, and grey for no result yet. HIGH priority never makes an object red, because the ТЗ says risk is not a violation. Evidence is shown in OpenSeadragon over PyMuPDF raster tiles rendered on the server, with SVG overlays in normalized coordinates. Pilot sheets are A0 pages with up to 113k vector paths; measured render time is 0.6–1.8 s per full page and 0.1–0.2 s per tile. Using the same engine as the coordinate extraction keeps bboxes aligned on rotated or cropped pages. Module 8 adds a typed trigger_rule (ABS/RATIO/DELTA/DIRECTIONAL/ORDINAL/PRESENCE/EXTERNAL/SEMANTIC) and defines what min_value/max_value mean for each type. This matters because only about 26 of the 132 triggers are plain numeric thresholds. Thresholds can be inherited from Normative_Base rows with validity dates; every save publishes a new matrix_version snapshot with a mandatory reason, an audit entry, a RabbitMQ event and a Redis cache reset, and engines load the current snapshot at the start of each run. PDF, DOCX and XML exports all come from one Python worker (a Word template filled by docxtpl, LibreOffice for PDF, XML checked against our own XSD), so the missing Приложение № 2 only means editing the Word template later. Results are fetched by polling with ETag at 2/15/30-second intervals, which fits the pull model and the load of 100 concurrent inspectors. The report lists 90 UI requirements, 22 ТЗ ambiguities (including duplicate parameters that could double-count violations, and suspicious thresholds in M-117 and M-119), 16 decisions for the user, and 30 tasks for four implementation agents.

summary: B09 is the platform block that every other block leans on. It owns the ИАИС «РиН» integration (module 6), the audit log and protocol versioning (module 9), monitoring and logging (module 11), the §11 performance targets and the §12 security requirements. Its day-1 conventions must land before any feature code: request_id, the 6-field JSON log format, the auditService API, the RBAC permission matrix, the RabbitMQ envelope and outbox, config flags and the compose topology. There is no real РиН access, so we build a mock РиН with its own OpenAPI 3.0 contract using the literal ТЗ paths. It checks signatures and payload schema, simulates the prescription states (ISSUED..EXTENDED) and can inject failures (503, timeout, bad signature). Sending runs through a transactional outbox and RabbitMQ with TTL/DLX retry tiers (1/5/15 min, compressed to seconds for the demo). The protocol stays PROTOCOL_FINALIZED while delivery is PENDING_SYNC, and every attempt is journaled. Once retries are exhausted, a health probe restarts delivery when РиН comes back. Documents pulled from РиН never re-check a finalized protocol; the inspector is notified and offered «Создать новую проверку». A certified УКЭП/CryptoPro setup is out of reach, so a pluggable signer produces real GOST R 34.10-2012/Streebog signatures from a pure-TS library (not a legally qualified УКЭП), cross-checked by Python gostcrypto, and mTLS uses dev-CA certificates; the production swap is documented. The audit log is append-only and tamper-evident (hash-chain seals signed with GOST). Domain events are written in the same transaction as the change; read and access events are batched. Protocol versions are immutable snapshots with history and a diff view; un-finalization needs supervisor or admin, a reason and a password re-check. Monitoring uses pino/structlog, Prometheus, 5 Grafana dashboards as code, Alertmanager alerts to email (Mailpit) and Telegram, an optional ELK profile with 90-day/365-day retention, a daily file-hash check and a Monitoring_Metrics snapshotter. Security covers argon2id login, Redis/Valkey sessions, 6 roles, TLS 1.3 at the edge, AES-256-GCM encryption for stored files and PII columns, ClamAV that rejects uploads when it is down, rate limits plus lightweight intrusion rules, and encrypted daily backups with 30-day retention plus WAL archiving. On the M2 Max, §11 rows 1, 4–11 and 15 look achievable; OCR (rows 2–3) is risky for large-format raster scans; SLA/RTO/RPO (rows 12–14) will be designed and rehearsed, not proven. A k6 plus benchmark harness fills an in-app «Соответствие ТЗ (НФТ)» page.

summary: Module 12 is cross-cutting. B10 owns the contracts and the proofs; the handlers stay in the owning blocks (intake B01, comparison B04, verification B05, ML B06, hypotheses B07, UI/normative B08, RiN/security B09). The design rests on the rule 'fail visible, never fail negative': every error, timeout, unreadable zone, unit mismatch or unresolved revision maps to a rejection, NOT_COMPARABLE, CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, MISSING_EVIDENCE or LOW_QUALITY/ABSTAIN, and never to NEGATIVE_VERIFIED or CANDIDATE. This protects both the §14.3 FPR cap and the negative GOLD set, and is enforced by 11 property-tested invariants. One RFC 9457 problem+json envelope (Russian title/detail plus a stable code, request_id, retryable, errors[], actions[]) and one errors.yaml catalog, generated into TS, Python, OpenAPI, the web client and docs, replace the four error shapes and roughly 15 conflicting codes in the sibling reports; a reconciliation table is provided for AG-00. Experiments with PyMuPDF and pikepdf on 25 generated fixtures and the original PDFs changed the design in three ways. First, the organizers' own pilot kit is 51.49 MiB, so the ТЗ 50 МБ limit rejects it and the demo must use per-source split files. Second, the pilot file raises benign pikepdf/MuPDF stream warnings while a bit-flipped file is only detectable through structural warnings and a page-count mismatch, so corruption is classified as fatal, repairable or benign rather than 'any warning means corrupted'. Third, the only CONFIRMED_VIOLATION (OKT103) is a 200 dpi scan with handwriting and a seal, so quality handling is zone-level ABSTAIN, not file rejection. The catalog has 236 scenarios across 12 domains, plus consolidated retry/timeout rules, a dependency degradation matrix and a UI error-pattern spec (inline, file-row status, registry reconciliation panel, toast with request_id, banners, blocking modals). It also covers a deterministic negative-fixture generator (~150 fixtures), an automated suite (API contract, chaos via toxiproxy, Playwright UI, schemathesis fuzzing, hypothesis invariants, k6) with a coverage gate, and a live admin 'Самопроверка' page that runs about 60 jury-visible scenarios in under 2 minutes using DEMO_TIME_SCALE. MVP stance: every ТЗ-mandated negative behaviour is FULL; handwriting detection, IDS/DDoS and the RTO/RPO drill are SIMPLIFIED; the УКЭП client certificate to RiN is MOCKED; a certified network IDS is OUT_OF_SCOPE.
